speaker: will_kemp
text: They would not let me off. A quarter of an hour, and the yard still beating the boards. I am wet through.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: I stood at the door. A man who cannot keep to eleven set lines keeps time to a hair for two hundred bars.

speaker: augustine_phillips
text: He'll keep anything he made himself.

speaker: will_kemp
text: First on the paper, and first in the slippers. I was a cobbler. The shoes were the play.

speaker: arthur_meeks
text: I was the scold. The kirtle is borrowed, and the hem is short, and I did not trip.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: I will tell no one thou didst trip, because thou didst not. The hem is not mine to mend.

speaker: sam_latchet
text: I stole the shoes. I gave them back. Master Phillips, was the stealing the end.

speaker: augustine_phillips
text: The stealing is the end, Sam. Thou didst it in time. That is the whole praise, and it is enough.

speaker: (the tabor boy)
text: He stamps ahead of the bar and then he is on it. I kept the beat. I do not know how he comes back.

speaker: will_kemp
text: I made it. A man is not late in his own dance. The yard does not forgive a cobbler who loses the bar. It kept me, which is better.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: You have had the stage. Eleven of my lines would not have held them. Two hundred bars of yours did.

speaker: augustine_phillips
text: Let him have it. The cittern is hot in the hand. I am not making a lesson out of a dance that worked.

speaker: arthur_meeks
text: I shouted. A scold may shout. I am glad the kirtle was mine for the quarter-hour, and I am gladder to be out of it.

speaker: sam_latchet
text: May I wear the yellow ones once. I will not stamp. I only want the height of them.

speaker: will_kemp
text: You will not. They are taller than your knee. First in the slippers means me, not a prentice who has stolen them once already.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Augustine, the measure was yours and the room was his. I am not taking either. I am going home to a king who does not dance.

speaker: augustine_phillips
text: Go, then. The slippers can stay where they are. God keep you on the road.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: And you. Sam, thou didst steal them in time. That is a whole part. Do not improve it.

speaker: sam_latchet
text: I can do it again if everyone stops telling me the end before I get there.

speaker: arthur_meeks
text: Do not do it again tonight. I have shouted enough for one borrowed skirt.

speaker: will_kemp
text: Enough. The yard has had us. I am for a dry shirt. You may put the duke to bed. He had his afternoon.

speaker: (the tabor boy)
text: The drum is covered. I am not playing him off the stage a second time.

speaker: augustine_phillips
text: Leave it covered. A quarter of an hour was the dance. A second quarter would be a riot, and I am fond of my cittern.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Then it is covered. Eleven lines, two hundred bars, a quarter of an hour. I have the three.

speaker: will_kemp
text: Three is a good boast if you say it where it can be heard. Say it. I was first.

speaker: arthur_meeks
text: He was first. I was loud. Sam was a thief in time. That is the cast.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Go. The door has seen enough. God keep you.
